Plugin.Name: Vast.ai Monitor
Plugin.Overview:
Adds a dashboard tile for your Vast.ai host machines.
Shows each machine's state (rented on-demand, interruptible or reserved, listed, unlisted or offline), what it earns per hour and per day, the share of its GPUs that are rented, GPU model and VRAM, GPU temperature and host reliability score. An expandable details row adds CPU, RAM, storage and network bandwidth. A summary line shows combined earnings across the fleet and your account balance.
Answers from Vast.ai are cached on the server, so several open dashboards share one request. While the API is unreachable the tile shows the last good answer, labelled as stale with its age, and waits before trying again.
Requires a Vast.ai host account and an API key. Create a restricted key that can only read machines and read account info. The key is kept in plaintext in the plugin's settings file on the flash drive, and it is included in Unraid Connect flash backups if you use them. Uninstalling blanks the key in that file. It does not remove it from backups, so delete the key in the Vast.ai console when you stop using the plugin.
